comments.author: fisuhan
comments.text:
1:40:31
I’m a regular Dive Club viewer, but somehow I only discovered the live events last week. Guess the algorithm finally gave me a push 😄

Really loving the format. The raw conversations and unfiltered opinions are easily my favorite part. I just wish the time zone worked better for me. Watching live and actually interacting would make it even more fun, but I usually have to catch the recording instead.

Keep these coming!

comments.author: @alxdoyle
comments.text: The metaverse era gets written off as a joke, but I think the work there will likely become relevant again. It was the last time brands asked how they behave in a space where they don't control the framing. Right idea, technology wasn't ready

comments.author: @alxdoyle
comments.text: Which is why the Ramp conversation from last week is the closest thing I've seen to an answer. Cohesion over consistency. Jazz. A brand that behaves rather than one that gets applied.

comments.author: @alxdoyle
comments.text: You're right Tommy, social was the last real shift, and it got absorbed, it's now a section in the guidelines about colour application and logo size. Generative interfaces can't be absorbed the same way. You're writing a framework for outcomes you'll never see.
